Chapter 7183: Wrathful Annihilation

Chapter 7183: Wrathful Annihilation

Empress Hong Tian unleashed her grand seal, causing the sky to turn dark around Gu Chun and Skyshroud.

The two had no choice but to abandon killing Hao Hai and Violet Abyss, activating their strongest defense instead.

Gu Chun summoned a bronze wall blessed by countless laws and refinements. Skyshroud chose to use devouring black laws; each strand seemed to have been made from worlds and lives.

Nonetheless, her seal still obliterated their defenses and sent them flying while vomiting blood. They attempted to hide again, biding time for another ambush.

However, she stomped space and crushed all affinities. Dimensions became unstable waves, leaving them no room to hide.

“Just the two of you?” She stared at them with disdain.

Although she wasn’t as strong as ancient celestial immortals such as Heavenfall and Dusk, she could dominate just like them due to her dao heart and suppressive techniques.

Not to mention immortals, she would not yield before the high heaven. The duo felt as if her pressure was crushing them.

Moreover, both sides knew that just the two of them were insufficient to deal actual damage to Desolate Frontier. Someone else must be behind them.

“Pure Void Origin.” Gu Chun didn’t give up and waved his hand, turning the dao into chaos.

Space was refined immediately and converged into a single point ruled by Gu Chun alone. He aimed to trap and crush her in his domain.

“Stygian Edge Domain.” Skyshroud didn’t fall behind and turned the sky into darkness, creating a black hole of blades.

Hong Tian’s fingers curved like a blooming orchid before pressing downward: “Against Heaven, Wrathful Annihilation.”

“Rumble!” The duo’s techniques exploded and they smashed through numerous dimensions, unable to stop vomiting blood.

“Know your limit.” Hong Tian uttered coldly.

“We’ll see about that.” Gu Chun and Skyshroud exchanged glances before poking their eyes blind.

“Pop!” When they opened their eyes again, they gained dreadful tribulations. The bright bolts twisted together and formed a lightning portal.

Someone walked out, pulsing with the high heaven’s light. However, this didn’t erase his own light.

“Mang.” Hong Tian’s expression became serious.

“Mang, Devouring Alliance’s progenitor!” Spectators were shocked to see him.

“Controlling the dead.” Hong Tian said while staring at the two: “You have joined this so-called High Heaven Sect.”

“Delivering justice in the eternal high heaven’s stead. It is the only way to survive.” Gu Chun said.

“The high heaven has always stood alone.” She said.

"That's in the past. Now, the high heaven will take charge and we shall be the messengers.” Skyshroud laughed.

Others couldn’t believe what they were hearing. The high heaven had never needed messengers from the mortal world before.

However, if this was not true, where did their power come from? When was High Heaven Sect created?

“Then the high heaven should die.” Hong Tian said before punching: “Six Dao’s End, High Heaven’s Demise!”

This punch wielded total destruction, forcing Mang to summon a sword made from lightning tribulations for retaliation.
